title: ObjectUserBody and ObjectGenericODE2: implement them with the Exudyn conventions and one shared pattern
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.3.4 (decided: static functions, EvaluateMatrix with an integer switch, StdVector used internally instead of the Exudyn vectors; check both objects): the review of both objects is in the plan step; to be decided item by item before the change
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody and ObjectGenericODE2 are implemented with one pattern: the user functions get numpy views of Exudyn vectors without intermediate copies, a result of the wrong size names the user function and the sizes, and the derivative of a user body's Jacobians uses the step of the numerical differentiation of the solver
